name: Min Tanaka
bio: Min Tanaka is a Japanese actor and dancer. He won the award for best supporting actor at the 26th Japan Academy Prize for The Twilight Samurai.

credits.title: Godzilla Minus Zero
credits.overview: War reduced Japan to zero, and Godzilla plunged it into minus. Two years have passed since then, and the country has faced agonizing struggles to achieve recovery and finally reclaim its daily life. credits.title: A Pint of Ink
credits.overview: Through photographs, home videos, letters and personal recollections, Ester Geislerová composes a portrait of Japanologist, translator, journalist, educator, calligrapher—and her father—Petr Geisler, a charismatic charmer who remained mysteriously elusive even to his closest family.

credits.title: Sheep in the Box
credits.overview: In the near future, architect Otone Komoto is married to Kensuke, who runs a construction company. The married couple decide to welcome a humanoid robot into their home as their son.

credits.title: Ryuichi Sakamoto: Diaries
credits.overview: Ryuichi Sakamoto was an extraordinary musician who passed away in March 2023. He meticulously chronicled his final days in his personal diary. By tracing the last three and a half years through his journal, one can see how he confronted the end of his life and the legacy he sought to leave behind.

credits.title: Kokuho
credits.overview: Nagasaki, 1964: Following the death of his Yakuza father, 15-year-old Kikuo is taken under the wings of a famous Kabuki actor. credits.title: Black Ox
credits.overview: The life of a man, transitioning from a hunter-gatherer existence in the mountains to a life in the farm. One day, he comes across an ox, which somehow, he succeeds in leading back to his home. He lives with the animal, which becomes his companion in a life of changing seasons.

credits.title: The Real You
credits.overview: Why had a mother who seemed happy desired to end her own life? Desperate to uncover his mother’s true intentions, Sakuya ventures into uncharted technological territory. He turns to VF (Virtual Figure), a technology that aggregates personal data from one’s life to create a “human” in a virtual space.

credits.title: Who Were We?
credits.overview: On Sado Island, Kii works as a cleaner at a gold mine. One day, she finds a collapsed woman in the facility and takes the woman to her home. credits.title: Ryuichi Sakamoto's Last Days
credits.overview: Ryuichi Sakamoto shocked the world with his techno music as a member of YMO and continued to capture the hearts of many with his unique music. credits.title: Perfect Days
credits.overview: Hirayama is content with his life as a toilet cleaner in Tokyo. Outside of his structured routine, he cherishes music on cassette tapes, books, and taking photos of trees. Through unexpected encounters, he reflects on finding beauty in the world.

credits.title: Some Body Comes Into the Light
credits.overview: A beautiful session between dancer Tanaka Min and director Wim Wenders that illustrates something before we started speaking with words.

credits.title: Mom, Is That You?!
credits.overview: Akio, an HR worker, visits his transformed mother Fukue in Tokyo. Baffled by her new lively self, he encounters a friendly neighbor. Through these interactions, Akio gains new perspectives, noticing overlooked aspects of life.

credits.title: Father of the Milky Way Railroad
credits.overview: Kenji, the eldest son of Masajiro, a wealthy moneylender, refuses to work in the family business and becomes obsessed with farming, jewelry and religion.

credits.title: Amnesiac Love
credits.overview: This story follows the journey of an ill-fated young man whose ambition is to be a professional antiques dealer. A hard-up young man, who makes his living by selling old items in flea markets, meets a nurse and he falls in love with her. He decides to become a successful antique dealer. credits.title: Ghost Book
credits.overview: The forbidden book that will make any wish come true  "The Ghostly Book of Books".  However, in order to make your wish come true  you have to go through a life-threatening trial.  What is that trial...?

credits.title: The Pass: Last Days of the Samurai
credits.overview: In the turbulent last days of the Edo period, Kawai Tsugunosuke, a Japanese samurai serving the Makino clan of Nagaoka, dreamt of independence from the restraints of vassalship. credits.title: The Unnameable Dance
credits.overview: The Unnameable Dance shows the life and dance of Tanaka Min, an elderly dancer in his 70s, in a multifaceted and dynamic manner.

credits.title: HOKUSAI
credits.overview: The unknown life of Ukiyo-e artist Katsushika Hokusai in the Edo period, who is said to have painted more than 30,000 works throughout his life, such as "Thirty-Six Views of Mount Fuji"

credits.title: A Morning of Farewell
credits.overview: Sawako worked as an emergency physician at a university hospital. Due to to a situation, she returns to her father Tatsuro's home in Ishikawa Prefecture. credits.title: The Supporting Actors in Byplaywood
credits.overview: In a studio at the foot of Mt. Fuji, Gaku Hamada is struggling to shoot a movie with a dog in the lead role. Enter a huge cast of veteran actors who get involved in misadventures while on set.

credits.title: Four Women Living in That House
credits.overview: A mother, daughter and two of their friends live in an old Western-style house in Suginami. As secrets are revealed, they face challenges together.

credits.title: The Great War of Archimedes
credits.overview: It is the early 1930s and the command of the Japanese Imperial Navy determines to construct the world's biggest and most formidable battleship, Yamato. credits.title: Children of the Sea
credits.overview: Ruka is a young girl whose parents are separated and whose father works in an aquarium. When two boys, Umi and Sora, who were raised in the sea by dugongs, are brought to the aquarium, Ruka feels drawn to them and begins to realize that she has the same sort of supernatural connection to the ocean that they do. credits.title: Ninomiya Kinjirou
credits.overview: Ninomiya Kinjirou is a biopic follows the life of the eponymous character, an 18th century peasant boy who worked to rescue over 600 poor villages and hamlets from financial ruin by developing new economic policies.

credits.title: Svaha: The Sixth Finger
credits.overview: Pastor Park, the head of a religious investigation center that exposes cults and cult leaders, begins looking into a suspicious new religion called Deer Mount.

credits.title: The House Where the Mermaid Sleeps
credits.overview: Kaoruko and Kazumasa Harima are a separated couple with two children. They plan to divorce once their daughter, Mizuho, enters elementary school. credits.title: Modest Heroes
credits.overview: Two tiny, aquatic humanoids search for their missing father, a boy battles a lethal allergy to eggs, and an invisible salaryman tries to become a hero.

credits.title: Vision
credits.overview: Centres on Jeanne, a journalist tracking a mysterious rare herb that appears only once every 997 years.

credits.title: The Outsider
credits.overview: A former American G.I. joins a yakuza family after his release from prison in post-World War II Osaka.

credits.title: The Scythian Lamb
credits.overview: Six unknown people move to the declining seaport city of Uobuka. Unremarkable city official, Tsukisue, is appointed to welcome them, but finds out the shocking truth that all of them are former murder suspects. Before long, an uneasiness begins to creep over the quiet city.

credits.title: Destiny: The Tale of Kamakura
credits.overview: Set in an alternate universe, the ancient capital of Kamakura is a vibrant town where fantastical creatures live alongside humans. credits.title: Blade of the Immortal
credits.overview: Manji, a highly skilled samurai, becomes cursed with immortality after a legendary battle. Haunted by the brutal murder of his sister, Manji knows that only fighting evil will regain his soul. credits.title: Haruneko
credits.overview: Those who want to die seek refuge in a mysterious café in this feverishly strange Japanese debut.

credits.title: Onihei Crime Files: The Final Kohen - Unryu Ken
The Ark in the Mirage
credits.overview: A young man, involved with a gang of hoodlum exploiting vulnerable elderly men to steal their retirement money, experiences social disenchantment, alienation and confusion mostly due to a lack of dreams and fulfillment of ambition.

credits.title: Summer on the Frontline: A Boy's Story
credits.overview: Keisuke, 15-year-old junior-high school boy, has been forced to live as refugees with his family in temporary housing apart from a hometown as a result of the Great East Japan Earthquake.In 2012, he belongs to a broadcasting club of his junior-high, to which he has to be admitted for the earthquake. credits.title: Rurouni Kenshin Part III: The Legend Ends
credits.overview: Shishio sets sail in his ironclad ship to bring down the government. In order to stop him, Kenshin trains with his old master to learn his final technique.

credits.title: Rurouni Kenshin Part II: Kyoto Inferno
credits.overview: Kenshin has settled into his new life with Kaoru and his other friends when he is approached with a request from the Meiji government. Makoto Shishio, a former assassin like Kenshin, was betrayed, set on fire and left for dead. He survived, and is now in Kyoto, plotting with his gathered warriors to overthrow the new g

credits.title: The Eternal Zero
credits.overview: A brother and sister learn their biological grandfather was a kamikaze pilot who died during World War II. During their research into his life, they get conflicting accounts from his former comrades about his character and how he joined his squadron.

credits.title: 47 Ronin
credits.overview: Kai—an outcast—joins Oishi, the leader of 47 outcast samurai.  Together they seek vengeance upon the treacherous overlord who killed their master and banished their kind.  To restore honour to their homeland, the warriors embark upon a quest that challenges them with a series of trials that would destroy ordinary warri

credits.title: The Tale of Iya
credits.overview: As a tunnel construction project threatens the natural order of one of Japan's last untouched regions, an old man and his granddaughter Haruna's humble lifestyle begins to influence the outlook of a man from Tokyo.

credits.title: Black Dawn
credits.overview: With nuclear war on the horizon, a Japanese cop and an undercover American agent team up to find confidential documents that could start World War III.

credits.title: Rebirth
credits.overview: After the collapse of their relationship, Kiwako abducts the 6-month old child of a man she was having an affair with. Raising the child as her own, it is four years before the authorities catch up with her and the young child.

credits.title: Hokaibito: Ina no Seigetsu
credits.overview: Part documentary, part fiction this film revolves around the life of the haiku poet Seigetsu Inoue who wandered Ina Valley for about 30 years from the end of the  Edo period to the Meiji era.

credits.title: Map of the Sounds of Tokyo
credits.overview: A Japanese assassin falls in love with the Spanish wine seller she was hired to kill.

credits.title: Heaven's Door
credits.overview: A young man Tomoya Nagase and a girl Mayuko Fukuda both learn that they have an untreatable illness and are nearing death. When one reveals that they have never been to the ocean, they embark on a comical adventure to see the sea.

credits.title: Tekkonkinkreet
credits.overview: Two penniless orphans, Black and White, struggle to survive on the mean streets of Treasure Town. When a megacorporation threatens to tear down the town to build an amusement park, Black and White engage in the fight of their life.

credits.title: Riding the Metro
credits.overview: Shinji (Shinichi Tsutsumi) steps out of a train station to find himself transported back to 1964.

credits.title: La Maison de Himiko
credits.overview: Saori is a young woman struggling to make her way in life. Her gay father, Himiko, had abandoned Saori and her mother years before. credits.title: The Hidden Blade
credits.overview: Set in 19th Century Japan a young samurai who finds himself in love with a farm girl leaves his home to begin a new life. He has to take stock of his new life when he is put to the test and ordered to kill a traitor who just happens to be his dearest friend.

credits.title: The Twilight Samurai
credits.overview: Seibei Iguchi leads a difficult life as a low ranking samurai at the turn of the nineteenth century. A widower with a meager income, Seibei struggles to take care of his two daughters and senile mother. credits.title: Mountain Stage
credits.overview: A collaborative improvisational guitar and dance set featuring backing from crickets and cicadas.

credits.title: Oedipus Rex
credits.overview: Impressed by Jean Cocteau’s rewrite of Antigone, Stravinsky asked the poet for an adaptation of Oedipus Rex. credits.title: Butoh: Body on the Edge of Crisis
credits.overview: "Butoh: Body on the Edge of Crisis" is a visually striking film portrait shot on location in Japan with the participation of the major Butoh choreographers and their companies. credits.title: Min Tanaka à La Borde
credits.overview: Japanese butô dancer Min Tanaka performs at La Borde hospital for its residents. The residents reflect on the performance and the collective unconscious on camera. Among the residents speaking, one can spot actor Pierre Clémenti.
